pair_source_rule: use policy-verified pairs (data/cacrt_pairs_v1_policy) if >=100 corrective states retain >=1 pair; otherwise surrogate-verified pairs, reported as such

go_criteria.primary: heldout genuine_repair(EXP3) - max over {EXP1, EXP2, B7_replay} >= 0.05, paired cluster-bootstrap 95% CI > 0, pooled over 3 seeds
go_criteria.error_types: improvement present on RP (precondition) and RA (argument) separately, not driven by one
go_criteria.twin_specific: EXP3 > B7_replay on heldout genuine_repair or false_outage_rate with CI excluding 0
go_criteria.premise_gate: before arms: mean cos(g_DPO, g_twin) < mean cos(g_DPO, g_generic) on pi0 (analyze_interference --mode premise)
